annotations.title: Read one Storefront Kit topic or reference block

description: Public: with topic, that topic as Markdown; read assemble-a-shop, world-class-ordering-ux, verify-contract and the-return-page before building, the others when the steps name them. With block: where to read that reference block's source; read it, never install it. Without arguments: the topic and block lists. Read each topic once. Example: {"topic":"world-class-ordering-ux"}.

block.description: Optional reference block name from kit_learn's blocks, for example menu.

topic.description: Optional topic slug from kit_learn's topics, for example assemble-a-shop or verify-contract.
